To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the photon structure tensor is not a simple generalization of the hadronic tensor, 2) the effect of the target photon mass on the physical interpretation of photon structure functions is significant, 3) the QCD corrections to various structure functions are nontrivial and depend on the target virtuality, 4) there are new structure functions that are not present in the real photon case.

(a) the target photon mass effects on the photon structure function are non-trivial; (b) the target photon effects on the structure functions are not the same in the case of the unpolarised and the polarised structure functions; (c) the target photon virtuality effects can be understood as a result of the mixing of the transversity and helicity structure function in the case of polarised structure functions, and (d) the target photon effect is a higher twist effect and hence

the target photon mass effects are important and that they are not negligible in the region of the photon structure functions where the virtuality is comparable to the invariant mass squared of the hadronic state, and also that the relevant QCD correction factors are of the order of 1.2 to 1.3.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) the effect of target mass on the photon structure tensor; (2) the QCD corrections to various photon structure functions; (3) the physical interpretation of these new structure functions in terms hadronic components.
the following: (1) A systematic analysis of the effect of the target photon mass on the photon structure function.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the photon structure functions are not universal, and the effect of target mass is significant in all of the polarized structure functions and in the unpolarized ones.
the photon structure functions are not the same for real and virtual photons.
the effect of target mass is not negligible, and should be taken into consideration in any experimental or theoretical analysis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effect of photon mass is not negligible and should be taken into account in any realistic study of e+e− annihilation processes in the deep in elastic limit.
the target photon mass corrections and QCD corrections are important for the extraction of the photon structure functions, and should be included in the experimental analysis.

in the deep in elastic limit, the effect of target mass is to modify the structure functions in a way that the unpolarized photon structure function F2γ is modified by a factor (1+4M2γ/4q2), and a similar factor is present in the polarized structure function g2γ, while the other structure functions are unaffected.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of target virtuality is not a perturbative QCD correction but a non-perturbative effect.
the effect of photon mass is to introduce a new set of structure functions that are not present in the real photon case.
, unlike the case for real photons, the structure functions for a virtual photon are not simply the sum of the structure functions for the real photon and a target mass correction.
